our_interpretation: The plain reading is that degradation causes affected free users to leave or stop returning, reducing user growth relative to what would otherwise have occurred.
Growth can remain positive while being reduced by departures. Aggregate growth alone therefore cannot disprove the claim.
No deadline, minimum departure rate, or length of degradation is supplied.
